title: ATERNET
subtitle: Probabilistic solar forecasting
description: Adaptive temporal expert routing with dynamic quantile decoding. Uses weather forecasts and recent solar generation to predict PV output with P10, P50, and P90 uncertainty intervals.

title: Self-Healing RAG
subtitle: Retrieval that learns from its answers
description: A local-first RAG pipeline that evaluates answer quality, repairs weak retrievals, and adapts its retrieval settings. Combines hybrid search, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and an automated healing loop.

title: Collab AI
subtitle: A shared workspace for grounded AI
description: A collaborative AI workspace with private chats and real-time team rooms. Grounds answers in uploaded documents, preserves source citations, and keeps personal and shared retrieval separate.

title: Autonomous Rover Navigation
subtitle: From terrain perception to safe paths
description: Terrain analysis and navigation for rover and drone applications. Combines visual risk maps, A* path planning, YOLO cone detection, and waypoint generation for autonomous missions.

title: PhishLens
subtitle: ML-based phishing URL detection
description: Scores suspicious links using URL text features without visiting the target site. Combines tree models, a neural network, and anomaly detection with a web interface and batch scanner.

title: Fileless Malware Research
subtitle: Differential memory forensics
description: Research into suspicious in-memory activity. Currently includes a reproducible random-forest dataset baseline and a report dashboard; RAM acquisition and process-level differencing are planned.

title: SpyAware
subtitle: Windows security analysis
description: A Windows scanner that flags suspicious process, registry, file, network, and service activity. Organizes findings by risk in a web dashboard and produces PDF reports for review.

title: TicketFlow
subtitle: Real-time ticket booking
description: A movie and concert booking platform with live seat maps, expiring seat holds, concurrency-safe bookings, waitlist offers, and QR-code email tickets across Spring Boot microservices.

title: Expense Splitter
subtitle: Shared expenses, clearer balances
description: A group expense application with a React frontend and Java backend. Tracks shared expenses and balances, and simplifies debts into suggested settlement transactions.

title: LeaveTrack
subtitle: Leave management & approvals
description: A role-based Django platform with dynamic manager hierarchies, multi-level approvals, live leave quotas, REST APIs, and email notifications for employees and managers.
